verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover import pipelines for all three named formats. The FBX pipeline handles meshes, animations, materials and textures, glTF has import/export docs, and USD import and editing is documented. USD carries a Beta banner, and the pack contains no hands-on evidence that imports come through cleanly. Missing for 10: production-ready (non-Beta) USD support, detail on what glTF import preserves, independent or hands-on corroboration that imports are clean.

support.subject: As a technical artist, standard interchange formats — glTF, FBX, USD — import cleanly
